Read arithmetic wrappers, texture affine transforms, cubic five-tap history reconstruction. Generic A/B/C became left/right operands or multiplicand/multiplier/addend; sample coordinate, filter weights, and weighted channel sum roles are explicit. Transform ABI is shared and typed.

Traced predecessor-counter waits, staged K/V ring, query/key scores, exponential surrogate, probability row-sum transpose, probability/value MMA, padding correction, publication. Query/column/reduction tile loops and key/value/probability fragments replace M/N/K and A/B names.

Traced projection/contraction profiles, split input staging, residual seed, first/intermediate/final split publication. Shared fields now Input/Output/Residual/PackedWeights/SplitAccumulator/SplitCounters; accumulator, prior split, channel words and addresses are explicit.

Read 1024-to-4096 reduction pipeline, native activation, and packed publication. Register aliases and output vectors named by channel role; shared stage index has s_ prefix and token counts use g_ prefix.

Traced two K512 slices, per-head Q/K normalization, transposed V grouping, and serial split publication. Query/Key/Value and SplitAccumulator/SplitCounters name the ABI data flow; squared norm, inverse norm, accumulator words, and even/odd token groups name local roles.

Read the spatial/token layout address algebra. r_P became r_Parameters; bToTokenLayout names direction, compile-time words-per-token/alignment are named constants, copied word and token bounds are explicit. PhysicalWord arithmetic unchanged.

Read pixel hash, Box-Muller noise, depth-selected motion neighborhood, history samples, feature packing and conditioning overrides. ABI is shared typed FPreprocessParameters. Conditioning Green/Blue identify sampled texture channels used in multiplication; renderer semantics are deliberately not invented. Hash state, candidate depth and chosen motion offset renamed.
